newsitem.title: UK: Pakistan buys 50,000 T sugar in rail deal -traders.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys 50,000 T sugar in rail deal -traders.

text.p: Pakistan bought 50,000 tonnes of crystal white sugar for shipment by the end of December as a result of its recent buying tender, traders said on Tuesday. The purchase, to arrive in Pakistan by rail, at a reported price of $360 per tonne c & f basis, was split into two consignments of 37,500 and 13,500 tonnes, they said.
Details of the suppliers have yet to emerge.

The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) received nine bids from international trading houses in its original tender on December 7, issued because of a shortfall due to the delayed start of cane crushing season. -- Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
